requirements.quote:
An HTTP/2 implementation MAY treat the negotiation of any of the
   following cipher suites with TLS 1.2 as a connection error
   (Section 5.4.1) of type INADEQUATE_SECURITY:
requirements.condition: When any of the referenced following cipher suites is negotiated with TLS 1.2.
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation is permitted to treat the negotiation as a connection error of type INADEQUATE_SECURITY.
requirements.error_behavior: If the implementation elects to reject the negotiation, it may report a connection error of type INADEQUATE_SECURITY.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's response to negotiating a listed TLS 1.2 cipher suite can be observed, but the cipher-suite list is not present in this chunk, so the affected inputs cannot be identified from the supplied evidence alone.
